posts.title: Replace or Update Cabinets in a Kitchen Remodel
posts.excerpt: Decide whether to replace or update kitchen cabinets by weighing layout, condition, budget, and resale goals. This practical guide walks you through signs, costs, and preparation.

posts.title: How Much Does a Midrange Bathroom Remodel Cost?
posts.excerpt: A midrange bathroom remodel typically falls between $15,000 and $35,000. This guide breaks down what that includes, main cost drivers, timelines, and how to get a reliable estimate.
